I see people being negative here, but I personally really like some of the changes on the Travel Packs and am definitely considering picking one up. I already own the Globerider, and it's truly an incredible bag with an iconic profile, but I hate that it doesn't have a dedicated laptop compartment nor a space for my iPad. I also was personally never a fan of the kangaroo pouch because of how lumpy the bag's profile gets when you shove a jacket in there, and the water collection issues are a real pain point. On the Travel Pack, I appreciate the admin panel, which is MUCH improved vs the Globerider, with yet another space for a tablet, less prescriptive organization (3 pen slots on the GR35 is criminal), and good use of mesh. I personally also prefer the Garnet color to the more reddish colorway of the GR35, though I seem to be in the minority on that. I also really appreciate the way Matador actually *lowered* the price for this new iteration, which is commendable in this economy.Not to sound like a shill, and I wouldn't be saying this if I didn't truly feel it. If I have any criticism it's that Matador didn't find a way to keep at least limited stock of the GR35 available, though I'm sure it comes down to sales numbers and manufacturing etc. But I'm a bit surprised at the negative reception these updated bags have gotten. They're not as sexy or iconic as the last gen, but for me, the GR35 is a bag I'll take for very specific kinds of trips, while this looks like something I could bring with me in all sorts of situations, and serve me well.
